{
  "type_map": {},
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0))"
      ],
      "features": [
        "PROTOCOL",
        "TCP_FLAGS",
        "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS",
        "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS",
        "RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES",
        "RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS",
        "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES",
        "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS",
        "TCP_WIN_MAX_IN",
        "TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT"
      ],
      "rationale": "TCP-specific fields must be zero for non-TCP flows."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0) & (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0))"
      ],
      "features": [
        "PROTOCOL",
        "ICMP_TYPE",
        "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"
      ],
      "rationale": "ICMP-specific fields must be zero for non-ICMP flows."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | ((df['L4_SRC_PORT'] == 0) & (df['L4_DST_PORT'] == 0))"
      ],
      "features": [
        "PROTOCOL",
        "L4_SRC_PORT",
        "L4_DST_PORT"
      ],
      "rationale": "ICMP does not use ports, so port fields must be zero for ICMP flows."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "((df['DNS_QUERY_ID'] == 0) & (df['DNS_QUERY_TYPE'] == 0) & (df['DNS_TTL_ANSWER'] == 0)) | (df['L4_SRC_PORT'] == 53) | (df['L4_DST_PORT'] == 53)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "DNS_QUERY_ID",
        "DNS_QUERY_TYPE",
        "DNS_TTL_ANSWER",
        "L4_SRC_PORT",
        "L4_DST_PORT"
      ],
      "rationale": "DNS fields are only present when the flow uses the standard DNS port (53)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE'] == 0) | (df['L4_SRC_PORT'] == 21) | (df['L4_DST_PORT'] == 21)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE",
        "L4_SRC_PORT",
        "L4_DST_PORT"
      ],
      "rationale": "FTP command return code is only present when the flow uses the standard FTP control port (21)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['DURATION_IN'] == 0) & (df['DURATION_OUT'] == 0))"
      ],
      "features": [
        "PROTOCOL",
        "DURATION_IN",
        "DURATION_OUT"
      ],
      "rationale": "Stream durations are TCP-specific and must be zero for non-TCP flows."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "protocol",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'].isin([6, 17])) | ((df['L4_SRC_PORT'] == 0) & (df['L4_DST_PORT'] == 0))"
      ],
      "features": [
        "PROTOCOL",
        "L4_SRC_PORT",
        "L4_DST_PORT"
      ],
      "rationale": "Only TCP and UDP use ports; other protocols must have zero port fields."
    }
  ]
}
